why: Activity content of every modelled kind. Locks the row shapes both languages derive, and the part keys that keep a tool row stable across updates.

parts.text: Search the index first, then read the two most likely files.

activity.title: Thoughts
activity.detail: Search the index first, then read the two most likely files.

notes: These tool parts carry NO call_id, so they keep the legacy content-derived key (name + state + result[:80]). That key is unstable across a running->done update; tool_calls_with_ids.json is the same shape with the graph's run id, and is what new frames produce.
Locking both forms is deliberate: old transcripts must keep deduping the way they were written (plan section 6.7, one normalization adapter).
